content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an issue with the webserver of a [product_name] [version_no]. On the TD screen, it's possible to modify and deactivate both the day and the on time of a weekly timer using specific symbols. However, for the off timer, while I can change the value, I’m unable to deactivate it through the interface. The day parameter can be set or disabled (with "-------"), and the on timer can also be adjusted or disabled (using --:--), but no such option exists for deactivation of the off timer. Does anyone have a solution or suggestion? Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user points out inconsistent functionality in the web interface for a weekly timer on a [product_name] [version_no] web server. While day and on-time fields can be adjusted or disabled directly, the off timer option does not allow straightforward deactivation, which makes the control over the timer incomplete and confusing.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like all timer parameters, including the 'off timer,' to be adjustable and deactivatable in a consistent way through the web interface, similar to how the day and on timer fields operate.
